name: Andaz One Bangkok
positioning: Andaz hotel within the One Bangkok complex on Wireless Road, steps from Lumphini Park, blending modern design with Thai inspiration
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bangkok base beside Lumphini Park
Guests who want rooms and suites with views over Lumphini Park

facts.text: Andaz One Bangkok is located within One Bangkok, an urban lifestyle hub.
The hotel is on Wireless Road, steps from Lumphini Park.
The hotel is a few steps from Lumphini MRT station on the Blue Line.
The hotel blends modern design with Thai inspiration.
Rooms come with Byredo bath amenities.
Rooms include a complimentary minibar with non-alcoholic beverages and snacks.
The Andaz Suite has a deep soaking square bathtub overlooking Lumphini Park.
The Presidential Suite is on the top floor.
The hotel has a swimming pool.
Every stay includes a daily Sunset Hour with wines, beers, cocktails and bites.
Andaz Terrace has an open-air terrace with panoramic Bangkok skyline views.
Jing, the hotel's Chinese restaurant, serves Cantonese and Sichuan cuisine and dim sum.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows, most with views of Lumphini Park.
The Pool House suite has a private terrace with direct access to the hotel's pool.
Guests have access to the Andaz Lounge for 24-hour refreshments.
Piscari is a Mediterranean-inspired rooftop dining and bar venue on top of the hotel.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 31 km from Suvarnabhumi Airport.
Valet parking is complimentary for hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
